name: swiss-dummy-data
title: Swiss Dummy Data
description: Generates various random data commonly found in Switzerland, such as Social Security Number (SSN, aka «AHV»).
author: cmdr

commands.name: generate-ssn
commands.title: Generate SSN
commands.subtitle: Generates a fake Social Security Number
commands.description:
Generates a fake Social Security Number with a valid check digit.

Also known as AHV Nummer.

preferences.name: history
preferences.title: History
preferences.label: Keep previously generated values
preferences.description: Show previously generated values below the new one.

preferences.name: historySize
preferences.title: History Size
preferences.description: Number of previously generated values to keep per command.

" && exit 1
